## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: All callers audited: a grep for max_resolution_attempts in .claude/, plugins/dso/, dso_ci_review/ returns zero hits in code files
- DD7: At least one test (unit or integration) confirms that read-config.sh review.max_cycles returns the configured value

## Overview
Update tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh to:
1. Rename the fixture key from review.max_resolution_attempts to review.max_cycles (line 44)
2. Rename test_review_max_resolution_attempts → test_review_max_cycles (lines 132-137): assert that read-config.sh returns the configured value for the new key name
3. Rename test_review_max_resolution_attempts_default → test_review_max_cycles_default (lines 139-150): assert empty when absent
4. Add NEW test test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias: given a config with ONLY review.max_resolution_attempts set (old key), assert read-config.sh review.max_cycles returns the old value (backward-compat alias)
5. Add NEW test test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias_deprecation_warning: same config, assert that read-config.sh emits a deprecation warning to stderr
6. Add NEW test test_review_max_cycles_takes_precedence: given a config with BOTH keys set, assert new key value wins

## Test Approach

### test_review_max_cycles
- Given: fixture config containing review.max_cycles=3
- When: bash read-config.sh review.max_cycles <fixture>
- Then: stdout is "3", exit 0

### test_review_max_cycles_default
- Given: fixture config without review.max_cycles
- When: bash read-config.sh review.max_cycles <fixture>
- Then: stdout is "", exit 0

### test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias
- Given: fixture config with review.max_resolution_attempts=7 (no review.max_cycles)
- When: bash read-config.sh review.max_cycles <fixture>
- Then: stdout is "7", exit 0

### test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias_deprecation_warning
- Given: fixture config with review.max_resolution_attempts=7 (no review.max_cycles)
- When: bash read-config.sh review.max_cycles <fixture> 2>&1 (capture stderr)
- Then: stderr contains "deprecated" or "review.max_cycles"

### test_review_max_cycles_takes_precedence
- Given: fixture config with BOTH review.max_cycles=4 AND review.max_resolution_attempts=7
- When: bash read-config.sh review.max_cycles <fixture>
- Then: stdout is "4" (new key wins), exit 0

## Implementation Notes
- The tests reference plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh via $SCRIPT variable
- Tests use tests/lib/assert.sh helpers (assert_eq, _snapshot_fail, assert_pass_if_clean)
- All new tests follow the pattern of existing tests in the file
- The backward-compat alias tests MUST FAIL before T2 (read-config.sh shim) is implemented — this is the RED phase requirement for the alias behavior
- Add .test-index RED marker for all new test functions referencing read-config.sh

## TDD Requirement
These updated/new tests must run BEFORE the read-config.sh shim is added (T2). New alias tests will fail RED. Existing renamed tests (max_cycles) will fail because the key is not yet renamed in the fixture config used by the runner. After T2 + T5 land, all tests go GREEN.

## .test-index requirement
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker [test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias] for plugins/dso/scripts/read-config.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] test_review_max_cycles exists in test-read-config-flat.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_max_cycles' tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh
- [ ] test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias exists in test-read-config-flat.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias' tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh
- [ ] test_review_max_cycles_takes_precedence exists in test-read-config-flat.sh
  Verify: grep -q 'test_review_max_cycles_takes_precedence' tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh
- [ ] .test-index has RED marker for read-config.sh alias test
  Verify: grep '\[test_review_max_resolution_attempts_alias\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] No references to old test name test_review_max_resolution_attempts remain
  Verify: ! grep -q 'test_review_max_resolution_attempts[^_]' tests/scripts/test-read-config-flat.sh || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
